name: SimpleMakefile
code:
CC ?= gcc
CFLAGS ?= -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -std=c11 -O2
TARGET ?= app
SRCS := $(wildcard src/*.c)
OBJS := $(SRCS:.c=.o)

all: $(TARGET)

$(TARGET): $(OBJS)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -o $@ $^

clean:
	rm -f $(OBJS) $(TARGET)

.PHONY: all clean
